channel.title: AgentiLoop Agent! Blog
channel.description: Deep dives into AgentiLoop Agent!, the native macOS AI agent.

item.title: Why Agent! Compacts at Half the Window, and the Three Bugs That Shrank It to 16K
item.description: How Agent!'s context compaction decides when to summarize a long task, and the September 28 fixes for fallback models, Ollama and a 272K Codex window.

item.title: Before the Model Gets a Vote: Inside Agent!'s Shell Guardrails
item.description: How ShellSafetyService, the daemon-side re-check and the Jev second opinion stop an AI agent from wiping your Mac, walked through the actual Swift code.

item.title: Agent! Now Runs on macOS 14.6 and Intel Macs: How We Got Off macOS 26
item.description: Agent! was built around Apple Intelligence on macOS 26. Here's how one day of #available gates and package bumps brought it to macOS 14.6 on Apple Silicon and Intel.

item.title: Welcome to the Agent! Blog: One App, Any AI, Total Command Over Your Mac
item.description: What AgentiLoop Agent! is, how it's built, and what this daily blog will cover, straight from the source code.

item.title: Meet Jev: A Second Opinion That Answers in Types, Not Prose
item.description: Agent! now asks Jev (TypeSafe System One) how destructive a shell command is before running it. Here's why Jev is an advisor and not another LLM provider.

item.title: Why We Ripped Out Coding Mode: Let the Model Pick Its Own Tools
item.description: Agent! used to guess whether you wanted coding or automation and hide tools to match. One broken Photo Booth task showed why the harness should stop second-guessing the model.
